title: Tiny, cute fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='8' y='76' width='84' height='6' rx='3' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- ladder -->
  <rect x='38' y='30' width='44' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c0c8d8'/>
  <rect x='38' y='30' width='44' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e8eef8'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='30' x2='46' y2='35' stroke='#8a92a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='30' x2='56' y2='35' stroke='#8a92a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='30' x2='66' y2='35' stroke='#8a92a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='30' x2='76' y2='35' stroke='#8a92a8' stroke-width='2'/>

  <rect x='20' y='44' width='52' height='30' rx='5' fill='#e83030'/>
  <rect x='20' y='44' width='52' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff5a5a'/>

  <rect x='25' y='48' width='28' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c8ecff'/>

  <rect x='24' y='62' width='44' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff5a5a'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='74' r='10' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='74' r='5' fill='#c0c8d8'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='74' r='2' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='74' r='10' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='74' r='5' fill='#c0c8d8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='74' r='2' fill='#ffdd44'/>

  <circle cx='81' cy='60' r='4' fill='#ffee66'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='60' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- siren -->
  <rect x='66' y='33' width='10' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  <rect x='66' y='33' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#fff8b0'/>
  <!-- siren light burst -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='31' r='2' fill='#ffee66'/>
  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x='76' y='68' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#d8dce8'/>
  <!-- hose coil -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#d8dce8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='2' fill='#ffdd44'/>
